artifacts.title: A typeface for code
artifacts.content: Build an open monospace typeface for code editors and terminals. Prioritize legible punctuation and make zero, capital O, one, and lowercase l easy to distinguish.

artifacts.title: Editor glyph tests
artifacts.content: Compared braces, brackets, operators, indentation, and dense code samples in terminal and editor mockups. The main success measure is reading code comfortably for long sessions.

artifacts.title: Small-screen tuning
artifacts.content: Adjusted spacing and hinting so code remains readable at small screen sizes. The project is still focused on developer tools.
